history.p: Already before the revised version of Hartmann's and Hans Christian Andersen's "Ravnen" had had its first performance, Andersen got an idea for a new opera text based on the biblical story about Saul and David. The work only progressed slowly, because Hartmann found that the subject and form did not match the predominant opera style of the 1860s. After the failure of "Ravnen", Hartmann wrote to Andersen that he had lost his fascination of opera. He never finished "Saul" but planned a concert performance of the fragment in Musikforeningen. It never took place.
